shots.prompt: Premium fragrance cinematography from this authentic photograph. Preserve the exact unbranded matte black round bottle, short cylindrical closed cap and curved shoulder. Extreme close product framing. A restrained silver rim reflection travels along the shoulder as the camera slides just two centimeters sideways. Deep charcoal blacks with visible edges, single narrow side softbox, elegant falloff and realistic material response. The bottle stays rigid and upright. No rotation, opening, liquid, mist, hands, labels, lettering or additional props. One continuous optical take. No speech, voices or music.
